title: The 10 Best Inground Pool Covers
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for inground pool covers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at inground pool covers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: WaterWarden Premium Pool Safety Cover for 12x20 Ft In-Ground Pool
products.blurb: Key specs: UL-classified per ASTM F1346, Solid vinyl, blocks nearly 100% of sunlight, 20-year warranty.
strengths: Genuine weight-bearing barrier, not just a debris shieldand classified under ASTM F1346
Solid vinyl blocks essentially all sunlight, the strongest algae control of any cover type
20-year warranty leads the safety cover category at this size
limitations: Requires a cover pump since rainwater and snowmelt pool on the solid surface
Custom anchor measurement to the deck adds cost and lead time versus a stock winter tarp
Blocks all solar heating, unusable as a swim-season cover
Heavier and harder to remove solo than a mesh equivalent
features: Solid vinyl, blocks nearly 100% of sunlight

products.name: WaterWarden Solid Vinyl Pool Safety Cover, Fits 18x36 Ft Rectangle
products.blurb: Key specs: Solid vinyl construction, ASTM F1346-rated, 18x36 ft rectangle fit.
strengths: Solid vinyl gives near-total sunlight blockage for strong algae suppression
18x36 fit covers a common mid-size inground rectangular pool without custom cutting
Deck-anchored spring system is the same structural design used on premium safety covers
Vinyl is easier to hose off and clean than mesh's woven texture
limitations: Needs a cover pump to clear standing water after rain
Warranty terms are shorter than WaterWarden's flagship Premium line
Heavier than mesh at this size, awkward for one person to manage
No solar heating benefit while installed

products.name: GLI Secur-A-Pool 18x36 Ft Rectangular Mesh Safety Cover with Center End Step
products.blurb: Key specs: Polypropylene mesh, ASTM F1346-rated, 18x36 ft rectangular fit, Center end step cutout.
strengths: Center step cutout matches how most stock rectangular inground pools are actually accessed
Mesh drains rain and snowmelt on its own, no pump to buy or maintain
Lighter than a solid cover of the same size, easier to remove and store
Strong enough to be walked on, a real ASTM-rated structural barrier
limitations: Blocks only about 92% of sunlight, weaker algae control than solid vinyl
Fine silt and pollen pass through the mesh weave onto the pool floor
Step cutout hardware is a fixed point that needs periodic inspection

products.name: WaterWarden Inground Pool Safety Cover 20x42 Ft Rectangle, Blue Mesh
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-rated mesh, 20x42 ft extended rectangle fit, Blue mesh construction.
strengths: 20x42 sizing covers longer lap-style pools that standard 20x40 stock covers don't quite fit
Mesh drains on its own, no pump needed for the extra square footage
Same ASTM-rated structural anchoring as WaterWarden's standard sizes
Blue color makes the cover easy to visually inspect for debris buildup
limitations: Extended length sizing costs more than standard 20x40 stock covers
Smallest rating sample (96) of any product in this roundup, less data to judge long-term reliability
Mesh blocks only about 92% of sunlight versus solid vinyl
Larger surface area means more weight and a harder solo install

products.name: Robelle 20x40 Ft Heavy Duty Green Winter Pool Cover for Inground Pools
products.blurb: Key specs: 8x8 scrim-reinforced polyethylene, 10-year warranty, 20x40 ft sizing with 5-ft deck overlap.
strengths: 5-ft overlap sizing is measured specifically for inground decks, water bags land on solid ground instead of hanging off the coping
8x8 scrim reinforcement resists wind-flap tearing better than unreinforced tarps
10-year warranty is solid for a mid-tier winter tarp
limitations: Not weight-rated, still a tarp and unsafe to walk on regardless of how taut it looks
20x40 size is heavy enough to typically require two people for installation
Requires separately-purchased water bags or anchor hardware
Standing rainwater pools on the surface without a cover pump

products.name: Robelle 16x32 Ft Heavy Duty Blue Winter Pool Cover for Inground Pools
products.blurb: Key specs: Standard-gauge polyethylene, 16x32 ft sizing with deck overlap, 8-year warranty.
strengths: Lowest price point of the winter tarps in this roundup while still sized correctly for inground deck overlap
16x32 fits smaller inground pools without paying for excess unused material
Lighter gauge than the Heavy Duty line makes it easier for one person to fold and store
limitations: 8-year warranty trails the Heavy Duty and Ultimate lines by 2 to 12 years
Standard gauge is more prone to wind-flap wear than scrim-reinforced tarps
Not weight-rated, same caution as any winter cover
Blue color fades and shows dirt more visibly over multiple seasons than charcoal

products.name: Robelle 20x40 Ft Ultimate Charcoal Winter Pool Cover, 20-Year
products.blurb: Key specs: 20-year warranty, longest in the winter tarp category, Ultimate heavy-duty charcoal fabric, 20x40 ft sizing with 5-ft deck overlap.
strengths: 20-year warranty is roughly double the standard Heavy Duty line's coverage
Charcoal color absorbs more residual heat, which helps ease ice stress against the pool wall
Ultimate-grade fabric is a heavier gauge than Robelle's standard tarps, more tear-resistant
limitations: Premium price relative to standard-gauge winter tarps
Not weight-rated regardless of the heavier fabric
Heavier material is more cumbersome to fold and store than lighter tarps
Dark color shows algae staining more visibly if left on too long into spring
features: 20-year warranty, longest in the winter tarp category

products.name: Blue Wave NS450 24x40 Ft Rectangle Solar Blanket for In-Ground Pools, 12-Mil Blue
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-mil UV-stabilized bubble material, 24x40 ft rectangle, rated for large inground pools, 5-year seam warranty.
strengths: 24x40 sizing covers large inground pools that smaller stock solar covers can't reach
12-mil thickness survives a full swim season of pool chemical exposure better than 8-mil covers
5-year seam warranty is above average for a solar blanket this size
limitations: Large surface area is heavy and essentially requires an in-deck or above-deck reel to manage
Solar covers on inground pools see the shortest lifespan of any cover type, typically 3 to 6 years
No structural weight rating, can't double as any kind of safety barrier
Higher price than smaller solar covers simply due to square footage
features: 24x40 ft rectangle, rated for large inground pools

products.name: Blue Wave NS492 12x24 Ft Oval Solar Blanket for In-Ground Pools, 12-Mil Clear
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-mil UV-stabilized clear bubble material, 12x24 ft oval fit for inground pools, Cuts evaporation and raises water temperature.
strengths: One of the few solar covers cut specifically for smaller oval inground pools rather than only rectangles
12-mil thickness holds up to chemical exposure better than thinner 8-mil covers
Clear material lets more sunlight through for slightly faster heat gain than tinted covers
Smaller 12x24 footprint is manageable without a dedicated reel system
limitations: Oval sizing is fixed and won't work for rectangular or freeform inground pools
Clear material shows algae and debris buildup more visibly than blue covers
Still a 3-to-6-year wear item on an inground pool given chemical exposure
No weight rating, purely a heating and evaporation product
features: 12x24 ft oval fit for inground pools
Cuts evaporation and raises water temperature

products.name: Pool Mate 20x40 Ft Blue/Silver Deluxe Solar Cover for Inground Pools, 8-Mil
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-mil UV-stabilized bubble material, 20x40 ft rectangle fit, Blue/silver reflective surface.
strengths: Lowest cost way to add solar heating to a standard 20x40 inground pool
Reflective blue/silver surface helps limit overnight heat loss
Lighter 8-mil material is easier to handle without a reel on smaller sections
limitations: 8-mil thickness typically lasts only 3 to 5 years, shorter than 12-mil covers
Thinner material punctures more easily on pool ladders and rough coping
Less heat retention than thicker 12 or 16-mil covers
At 20x40 the total sheet is still heavy and unwieldy to remove by hand despite the thinner mil rating

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
